messages:
sam: heads-up — trying to provision a small cross-region canary for the new optimizer workload. blocked by GPU quota in asia-northeast1. anyone seen a region-specific deny like this recently?

sam: full error from console:
```
Quota error: 403 Quota 'ACCELERATORS' exceeded for project infra-canary-77 in region asia-northeast1.
Please contact support to request GPU quota increase.
```

meera: what GPU SKU are you selecting? h100? l4?
sam: requesting h100-80gb. terraform instance_template uses accelerator type "nvidia-hopper-h100" and count 1.

alan: quick note: CloudVendorX changed their quota request flow — they now require a mapping record that ties our internal org code (RWD-INFRA) to their partner account. if the mapping isn't present quota increases can be applied but won't attach to our projects.
sam: weird, we filed a request yesterday via their portal. greg did you file on this one?

greg (procurement): I opened ticket CVX-24001 and supplied project infra-canary-77 and billing acct IA-987. vendor asked for exact internal partner ID and the SKU code; I didn't include our partner ID because it wasn't obvious in the portal. forwarding their note now.
vendor-bot: [CVX Support] CVX-24001 4:13 UTC  pending customer provide partner mapping and exact SKU string for H100.

meera: vendor sometimes wants SKU like "H100-80GB-REG" or their internal code "GPU_H100_80_REG_JP". can we standardize a table?

alan: yes please. Also try a quick test: spin up a non-accelerated VM in asia-northeast1 via console. if that works, it's definitely GPU quota. if it fails for any compute quota we have a different problem.
sam: non-accelerated VM works fine. confirmed only GPU SKU blocked.

greg (procurement): sent update: "Please apply GPU_H100_80_REG quota to project infra-canary-77 (billing IA-987) and attach to partner mapping RWD-INFRA; confirm region asia-northeast1." cc vendor rep.

vendor-bot: [CVX Support] CVX-24001 updated 4:22 UTC  Quota increase requested by vendor, awaiting internal routing. Expected propagation 30-90 minutes.

meera: fyi our terraform provider can also include `quota_project` in google provider block to route billing/quotas differently. if vendor applies to billing acct you may need to set that to the infra billing project.
sam: currently provider block: ```hcl
provider "google" {
  project = "infra-canary-77"
  region  = "asia-northeast1"
}
```

alan: add `quota_project = "infra-billing-ia987"` to test if it's a quota routing mismatch. that sometimes helps before vendor propagation finishes.
sam: trying that now. also opening a tiny MR to add the SKU mapping to our onboarding doc: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/ops/merge-requests/456

greg (procurement): vendor confirmed mapping applied and quota bumped to 3 in asia-northeast1. propagation note: "Changes routed to partner mapping. Allow up to 45 minutes."
vendor-bot: [CVX Support] CVX-24001 4:38 UTC  quota increased and partner mapping attached.

sam: added quota_project to provider and retried after 40m  terraform plan now shows resources to create. apply next.

ops-ci: [ci] canary-deploy pipeline started by sam. job 1122 queued, will hit the newly-provisioned machines if apply completes.

sam: terraform apply succeeded. created single canary VM with H100. marking CVX-24001 resolved and updating MR with closure msg.

meera: thanks — can we track this in the infra runbook? specifically: 1) exact vendor SKU table per region 2) partner mapping check before requests 3) sample procurement text.

greg (procurement): will add to ticket notes and link to MR. good catch on quota_project tip.

alan: we should also log a small automation task: scrape vendor portal for applied quotas and email slack-channel on change. puts less manual verification burden on procurement.
sam: yep opening a follow-up issue in infra backlog. thanks everyone. :rocket:
